objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving lifecycle in the system.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g., policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Short abbreviation code for the document type used in naming convention.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive 4-digit number assigned per document type.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The descriptive title portion of the document name.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the document, incremented upon content or relevant attribute changes.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the document within the status network (e.g., editing, released, out of force).

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: The scope or area of applicability of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document version is considered valid, set upon release.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document is valid, calculated from Valid From plus period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Time period defining how long a document remains valid before requiring a validity check (default 3 years).

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period for which an invalidated document is retained before physical deletion (default 10 years).

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data referenced by this document.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications associated with the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies to which the document is relevant.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Areas or regions where the document is applicable.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Person registered as the primary author of the document, automatically set to the creator.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional persons assigned personal change rights on the document.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person(s) assigned to check the document for technical and formal correctness.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person(s) responsible for approving and releasing the document.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group assignment controlling which readers may view the document.

attributes.name: distribution_by_email
attributes.description: User groups or persons automatically informed by email upon release of a new version.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: User groups or persons required to actively confirm acknowledgement upon release.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: The original file format of the document content (e.g., Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: The language of the document content, relevant for translation management.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specification of which clients in a multi-client system can see the document.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A document attachment that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and has no own release cycle, used for non-critical supplementary information.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document attachment that is automatically released with the main document and subject to its own versioning, triggering a new version of the main document upon creation, modification, or archiving.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new document objects.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal created by authors to suggest changes to an existing document without affecting its content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend or revise the document.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request created to invalidate a released document that has no additional validity, triggering archiving of the document and its attachments.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document, created by the Business Admin group.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A defined group of users in the system used to assign read and change authorizations to documents.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who interacts with the system in various roles such as author, reviewer, releaser, reader, or translator.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: An organizational entity within the company to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process defined in process management to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A risk object in the system that can be linked to documents.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Reference data objects such as IT applications that can be linked to documents.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list maintained per document containing user groups and persons who are informed about document releases.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process controlling the steps of document release, validity extension, override, reactivation, and acknowledgement.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature used by workflow participants to complete their tasks, documented per released version.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A role-specific user interface displaying relevant documents, tasks, and evaluations for the logged-in user.

objs.name: report
objs.description: A role-specific evaluation providing filtered results based on selection parameters and criteria.

objs.name: client
objs.description: A tenant in a multi-client system where documents can be made visible or restricted.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A user creates a new document object in the system by attaching a new information object with selection of document type and optional template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The author or co-author edits the content of a document using the implemented editing client in the corresponding Office component.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: The author or co-author maintains or updates the metadata and attributes of a document via property editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: The system automatically converts the saved document to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or change authorizations are assigned to the document by specifying user groups and persons for reader, author, co-author, reviewer, and releaser roles.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The author or co-author initiates the 3-step approval process (Creator - Review - Release) for the document.

evts.name: sign_as_creator
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step of the release process using an electronic signature.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document for technical and formal correctness and completes the task with an electronic signature.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document, completing the task with an electronic signature, making the document visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the approval workflow, causing the workflow to be canceled for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: The system creates a new editing version of a released document when content, relevant attributes, or attachments are changed.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: An author attaches a non-release-controlled additional information object to a document.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: An author releases and publishes additional information directly via switches in the properties without a release workflow.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An author deletes additional information from a document directly due to its non-critical nature.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: An author attaches a controlled attachment object to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An author modifies an existing attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next main document version, revoking all rights except for the archive group.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author creates a change proposal for an existing released document suggesting modifications without affecting the document content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document with a note about the existing change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of the assigned change proposal, triggering an email notification to the proposal creator, and the completed proposal is no longer displayed.

evts.name: generate_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before a document's validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The releaser (and optionally author and reviewer) confirms the extended validity of the document through a workflow-supported process.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a released document that has no additional validity.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The releaser (and optionally applicant and reviewer) approves the override request, setting the document status to out of force and triggering archiving.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: The Business Admin group creates a request to re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: The initiator confirms reactivation in the workflow, creating a new version of the document with restored metadata, authorizations, distribution list, and attachments.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: The system physically deletes an archived document after the archive duration has expired.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: The system automatically sends email notifications to users and user groups on the distribution list upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: The system automatically sends acknowledgement requests to users and user groups on the distribution list upon release, requiring active confirmation.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A reader confirms acknowledgement of a released document via a workflow-supported task without a signature.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: A translator translates the released content of a document into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated version of a document is checked and released with workflow support, making it visible to authorized readers in the corresponding language.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: An external file or document is uploaded to a created object cover in the system.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system sends email notifications to involved users about workflow status, tasks, validity extensions, overrides, and other document events.

evts.name: set_client_visibility
evts.description: A user specifies in which clients of a multi-client system a document is visible.

o2o.description: A document can reference other documents via the references attribute.
A document can be linked to organizational units for organizational filing.
A document can be linked to business processes for process-specific filing.
A document can be linked to risk objects in the system.
A document can be linked to master data such as IT applications.
A document can have additional information objects attached to it as non-critical supplements.
A document can have controlled attachment objects that are released with the main document.
A change proposal belongs to a specific document and is displayed within the document.
Each document has a distribution list maintained with user groups and persons for notification.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type and selected when creating new documents.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked for validity.
A request for override is created for a specific document to trigger its invalidation and archiving.
A request for reactivation is created to select a specific invalidated document for re-validation.
A distribution list contains assigned user groups who are informed about document releases.
A distribution list contains assigned persons who are informed about document releases.
A user group contains individual users who are members of that group.
A document can be made visible or restricted in specific clients in a multi-client system.
Electronic signatures of workflow participants are documented per released version of a document.
